data.content: 7 printable Thanksgiving games for family dinners, Friendsgiving and classrooms in one 11-page pack. Print at home on US Letter or A4 and play the same day. Instant download PDF.

120 original Christmas charades cards in 3 colour-coded levels: 40 for kids, 40 for the whole family and 40 for adults and office parties. Act it out or switch to Draw It mode with the same cards, then keep score on the team score sheet. 14 printable pages plus how-to rules and blank cards to write your own. Print at home on letter paper, cut and play tonight. Instant download PDF.
Put your 2027 goals on paper: year in review prompts, a life areas check-in, dream list, 3 big goals, 12-week breakdown and habit tracker. Printable goal planner for the new year, instant download.
Crown the best gingerbread house with certificates for kids, teen and adult divisions plus People's Choice. Printable gingerbread contest kit with score cards and ballots. Instant download PDF.

7 printable Friendsgiving games for adults: trivia, Would You Rather, Most Likely To, bingo, Find a Friend, leftover scramble and thankful toast cards. Made for a table of 6 to 20 friends. Instant download.

Every plate gets a label with allergen checkboxes so guests know what is in each cookie. Part of a printable Christmas cookie exchange kit with sign-up sheet, recipe cards and best cookie ballots. Instant download.
Host a cozy Christmas whodunit for 8 players: host guide, timeline, 8 character sheets, clue cards in 3 rounds and a sealed solution page. 16 printable pages. Instant download PDF.
120 Christmas charades cards in 3 levels: kids, family and adults. Act it out or switch to Draw It mode, then keep score on the team score sheet. 14 printable pages. Instant download PDF.

Everything for a Christmas cookie swap in 13 printable pages: invitations, host countdown, sign-up, swap rules, recipe cards, cookie labels, ballots, thank-you cards and box tags. Instant download PDF.

Make December about moments, not more stuff: one small family activity a day until Christmas, like a blanket fort night or a cocoa walk. Printable countdown activity cards with conversation questions. Instant download PDF.

Start 2027 with savings you can see: color-in challenges, a flexible any-amount tracker, sinking funds planner and debt thermometer. Printable, guilt-free money tracker for busy people. Instant download PDF.

A Christmas countdown your kids will remember: 24 printable activity cards, 8 blank cards for your own traditions, a countdown tracker and a supply list. Screen-free family fun for ages 4 to 12. Instant download PDF.
Missed a week? It still counts. This ADHD-friendly savings tracker has color-in challenges, a no-spend month tracker, sinking funds and a monthly money check-in. 14 printable pages, instant download.

Set a total, track spending by category and see what is left before December gets hectic. This printable Christmas planner includes a holiday budget page plus gift tracker, calendar and to-do list. Instant download PDF.

Keep every name, gift idea, price and bought or wrapped tick on one printable gift tracker. Part of a Christmas planner with a holiday budget, December calendar and dinner planner. Instant download PDF for busy parents and hosts.

Need a party game fast? Print Christmas trivia with 20 questions and an answer key, plus 7 more games like bingo, Would You Rather and a scavenger hunt. Great for family gatherings and office parties. Instant download.
